title: IMPORTANT REMINDER FOR STATES
lateQualifierDeadline: noon on Monday following their qualification meet
recommendation: It is recommended that coaches include all athletes they intend to qualify on their original state meet entry, with a notation that they intend to qualify. It is not required that they pay in advance of their qualification.
note: Late fees are payable to USAG-CT, and are not up to the discretion of the meet director.
level10Note: Level 10's may qualify one week before their State Championship; however, the Meet Director must know that the possibility of that gymnast qualifying exists.
